@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+/**
+ * Export service tests.
+ *
+ * Verifies that:
+ * - The HTML export works offline (no external requests in generated HTML)
+ * - Repository text is safely encoded (XSS prevention)
+ * - Provenance manifest is embedded
+ * - Deferred capabilities are clearly labeled
+ */
+
+import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
+import type { Snapshot, Graph, FilePage } from '../types/v1'
+import {
+  buildExportManifest,
+  generateStructuralHtml,
+} from '../services/exportService'
+
+const MOCK_SNAPSHOT: Snapshot = {
+  schema_version: '1.0',
+  id: 'abc123def456abc1',
+  project_id: 'proj001',
+  source: {
+    kind: 'zip',
+    archive_digest: 'deadbeef12345678',
+    display_ref: 'local upload',
+  },
+  manifest_hash: 'aabbcc',
+  policy_version: '1.0',
+  created_at: '2026-09-26T10:00:00Z',
+}
+
+const MOCK_GRAPH: Graph = {
+  schema_version: '1.0',
+  snapshot_id: 'abc123def456abc1',
+  fixture_only: false,
+  entities: [
+    {
+      id: 'root-1',
+      kind: 'repository',
+      label: 'test-repo',
+      path: '.',
+      child_count: 1,
+      metadata: {},
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'file-1',
+      kind: 'file',
+      label: 'main.py',
+      path: 'main.py',
+      file_id: 'file-001',
+      parent_id: 'root-1',
+      child_count: 0,
+      metadata: { language: 'python', size: 1024 },
+    },
+  ],
+  relations: [
+    {
+      id: 'rel-1',
+      source_id: 'root-1',
+      target_id: 'file-1',
+      kind: 'contains',
+      basis: 'observed',
+      evidence_ids: [],
+      unresolved: false,
+    },
+  ],
+  coverage: {
+    inventoried_files: 1,
+    parsed_files: 1,
+    unresolved_references: 0,
+    excluded_paths: [],
+    limitations: [],
+    truncated: false,
+    total_entities: 2,
+    returned_entities: 2,
+  },
+}
+
+const MOCK_FILE_PAGE: FilePage = {
+  schema_version: '1.0',
+  snapshot_id: 'abc123def456abc1',
+  files: [],
+  total: 1,
+  truncated: false,
+}
+
+describe('buildExportManifest', () => {
+  it('includes snapshot identity', () => {
+    const manifest = buildExportManifest(MOCK_SNAPSHOT, MOCK_GRAPH, MOCK_FILE_PAGE)
+    expect(manifest.snapshot_id).toBe(MOCK_SNAPSHOT.id)
+    expect(manifest.project_id).toBe(MOCK_SNAPSHOT.project_id)
+  })
+
+  it('lists all deferred capabilities', () => {
+    const manifest = buildExportManifest(MOCK_SNAPSHOT, MOCK_GRAPH, MOCK_FILE_PAGE)
+    expect(manifest.deferred_capabilities).toHaveLength(7)
+    expect(manifest.deferred_capabilities.some(c => c.includes('summaries'))).toBe(true)
+    expect(manifest.deferred_capabilities.some(c => c.includes('dependencies'))).toBe(true)
+    expect(manifest.deferred_capabilities.some(c => c.includes('ask'))).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('records entity and relation counts', () => {
+    const manifest = buildExportManifest(MOCK_SNAPSHOT, MOCK_GRAPH, MOCK_FILE_PAGE)
+    expect(manifest.entity_count).toBe(2)
+    expect(manifest.relation_count).toBe(1)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('generateStructuralHtml', () => {
+  let html: string
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    const manifest = buildExportManifest(MOCK_SNAPSHOT, MOCK_GRAPH, MOCK_FILE_PAGE)
+    html = generateStructuralHtml(MOCK_SNAPSHOT, MOCK_GRAPH, manifest)
+  })
+
+  it('produces valid HTML5 document', () => {
+    expect(html).toMatch(/^<!DOCTYPE html>/)
+    expect(html).toContain('</html>')
+  })
+
+  it('contains no external script or style references', () => {
+    // Must be self-contained — no http/https src attributes
+    expect(html).not.toMatch(/src="https?:/)
+    expect(html).not.toMatch(/src='https?:/)
+    expect(html).not.toMatch(/@import url\(https?:/)
+  })
+
+  it('embeds provenance manifest', () => {
+    expect(html).toContain('grepo-manifest')
+    expect(html).toContain(MOCK_SNAPSHOT.id)
+  })
+
+  it('labels deferred capabilities', () => {
+    expect(html).toContain('Integration Slot')
+    expect(html).toContain('not connected')
+  })
+
+  it('does not embed executable JavaScript', () => {
+    // The only <script> allowed is the JSON manifest block
+    const scriptTags = html.match(/<script[^>]*>/gi) ?? []
+    expect(scriptTags).toHaveLength(1)
+    expect(scriptTags[0]).toContain('application/json')
+  })
+
+  it('safely encodes repository-derived text', () => {
+    // Build a snapshot with a name containing HTML-special characters
+    const xssSnapshot: Snapshot = {
+      ...MOCK_SNAPSHOT,
+      source: { ...MOCK_SNAPSHOT.source, repo: '<script>alert(1)</script>' },
+    }
+    const manifest = buildExportManifest(xssSnapshot, MOCK_GRAPH, MOCK_FILE_PAGE)
+    const xssHtml = generateStructuralHtml(xssSnapshot, MOCK_GRAPH, manifest)
+    // The script tag should not appear in rendered content
+    expect(xssHtml).not.toContain('<script>alert(1)</script>')
+    expect(xssHtml).toContain('<script>')
+  })
+})
+
+// Make beforeEach available as a top-level import
+import { beforeEach } from 'vitest'
